changed: A long note on an item now wraps onto as many lines as it needs, instead of stopping at the width of the row.
fixed: On a phone, an item's marks and its ⋯ and drag handle now stay together on one line — a row too narrow to hold them all used to split them into two rows of icons that lined up with nothing.
On a phone, a long name in the People list no longer squeezes the item's own name down to a couple of letters.
In the editor's toolbar, opening the ⋯ menu or the My Gear panel no longer leaves the tooltip describing the button sitting on top of what it opened.
Picking someone's colour on a touchscreen no longer leaves the colour you tapped before it looking chosen as well.
